name: holdout_detector_disjoint_v3
description:
Detector-disjoint holdout subset v3 — 9 cases. Extends v2 (7 cases) with two new cases: natcomm_petruk_tlr (G-1: figure-vs-sourcedata count mismatch) and natcomm_florido_tac2 (label_swap: Vehicle/Osanetant labels inadvertently switched). All cases: anomaly types NOT covered by the duplicate-column / fixed-offset / paired-ratio / cross-sheet-reuse detector family. All discovered via correction notices or PubPeer. Use to test whether B3 FAR generalises beyond detector training distribution.

Anomaly type breakdown (7 distinct types across 9 cases):
  label_swap x2:                     ncb_cav2, natcomm_florido_tac2
  misaligned_records:                 ncb_clonalfish
  mislabeled_panel:                   ncb_lphn3
  assignment_inconsistency x2:        ncb_radioligand, ncb_nickelate
  pseudoreplication:                  ncb_spp1
  provenance_mismatch:               elife_neurexin_fig1b
  figure_vs_sourcedata_count_mismatch: natcomm_petruk_tlr

Note: Candidate C (natcomm_nguyen_mirna, provenance_mismatch Fig7f) pending verification. Suite will extend to v4 if confirmed.
